title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 5 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: Which club do you want to join?
I want to join the music club.
What can you do? I can play the guitar.

sentences.en: We make new friends in the club.

sentences.en: Can you swim? Yes, I can.

sentences.zh: 国际象棋社团很受欢迎。
